|[[Navier–Stokes equations|Navier–Stokes]]<br>[[Derivation of the Navier–Stokes equations|(and its derivation)]]
|1+3
|<math> \displaystyle 
  \rho \left( \frac{\partial v_i}{\partial t} 
              + v_j \frac{\partial v_i}{\partial x_j} \right) = 
  - \frac{\partial p}{\partial x_i} 
  + \frac{\partial}{\partial x_j} \left[ 
      \mu \left( \frac{\partial v_i}{\partial x_j} + \frac{\partial v_j}{\partial x_i} \right) 
      + \lambda \frac{\partial v_k}{\partial x_k} 
    \right] 
  + \rho f_i
 </math><br>
+ mass conservation: <math>\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial \left( \rho\, v_i \right)}{\partial x_i} = 0</math><br>
+ an [[equation of state]] to relate ''p'' and ''ρ'', ''e.g.'' for an [[incompressible flow]]: <math>\frac{\partial v_i}{\partial x_i} = 0 </math>  
|Fluid flow, gas flow
